WF3 - Cal.com Booking Webhook

After import:
1. Every Google Sheets node: pick your service-account credential.
2. 'Get Settings': choose 'WF0 - Get Settings'.
3. 'Alert Operator (Unmatched)': pick your Gmail SMTP credential.
4. n8n needs env vars CAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET=<your secret> and N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false, then restart.
5. Activate the workflow.
6. In Cal.com create the webhook:
   https://YOUR-NGROK-DOMAIN/webhook/cal-booking
   Events: Created, Cancelled, Rescheduled. Same secret as step 4.
